custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425733 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test, with vendor A and 4 on hand, and set it inactive.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425733 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Create an active part, part B, for this test, with vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425733 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then the button that starts a new return).
